# Keibai Finder (競売・公売物件一括検索＆相場分析ポータル)

> Keibai Finder (`https://www.keibai-koubai.com`) is Japan's comprehensive real estate auction (競売 - Keibai) and public tax auction (公売 - Koubai) intelligence platform, operated by TQC Corporation (TQC株式会社, Tokyo, Japan). It aggregates official court auction listings from the Supreme Court's BIT (不動産競売物件情報サイト), National Tax Agency (国税庁公売情報) listings, historical winning bid results (落札結果), and official market transaction prices from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (国土交通省 不動産情報ライブラリ MLIT API).

## Core Data Sources & Authority
- **Court Real Estate Auctions (不動産競売 - BIT):** Official court-ordered foreclosure listings across all 47 prefectures of Japan, including 3点セット (物件明細書, 現況調査報告書, 評価書) analysis, minimum bid price (売却基準価額), and bidding schedules.
- **Public Tax Auctions (国税局・税務署 公売物件):** Seized real estate listings published by the National Tax Agency and local municipalities.
- **Official Transaction Price Comparison (国土交通省取引相場連携):** Real-time comparison against nearby historical transaction prices per square meter from MLIT to calculate price discount gaps (`相場乖離率`).
- **Historical Auction Results (全国落札結果データベース):** Archive of past winning bid prices (`落札価額`), bid multiples (`落札倍率`), and bidder counts (`入札数`).

## Primary Navigation & Data Hubs
- [Portal Home (トップページ)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/): Real-time national summary, interactive map preview, 47 prefecture hubs, railway line hubs, and latest 12 listings.
- [All 47 Prefectures Directory (都道府県別 競売・公売一覧)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/search/area): Browse active court and public auction listings by prefecture and municipality (`/search/area/[prefecture]/[city]`).
- [Railway Lines & Stations Directory (沿線・駅別 競売・公売一覧)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/search/station): Browse properties by railway line and nearest station (`/search/station/[line]/[station]`).
- [Interactive Full-Screen Map Search (全国物件マップ検索)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/map): Geospatial search with MLIT zoning, disaster hazard overlays, and investment yield filters.
- [Historical Auction Results Database (全国落札結果データベース)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/auction-results): Search past court auction winning prices and bid ratios across Japan.
- [Auction Schedule Calendar (売却スケジュールカレンダー)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/auction/schedule): Court bidding periods (入札期間), opening dates (開札日), and publication dates.
- [MLIT Real Estate Transaction Price Finder (国土交通省 不動産取引価格検索)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/trade-find): Query official real estate transaction prices by area, building age, and station distance.
- [Market Insights Dashboard (市場分析ダッシュボード)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/market-insights): Prefectural supply/demand statistics and average starting price analytics.
- [Daily Featured Property Reports (本日の注目物件レポート)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/insights): Daily AI-assisted market reports and deep-dive investment analyses.
- [Keibai & Koubai Knowledge Base (競売・公売ナレッジ & コラム)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/blogs): Practical guides on bidding procedures, legal risks, occupancy eviction (引渡命令), and financing.
- [Verified Real Estate Agencies Directory (全国不動産会社・宅建業者データベース)](https://www.keibai-koubai.com/agencies): Directory of licensed real estate agencies for auction consultation and bidding support.
